title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 09
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. 

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

The Land of Cornucopias - Unreal Engine 5: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw

0:00 - Intro
0:20 - Beverage Choices
1:20 - NFT 2 Tree Mint Recap
3:36 - Our NFT Marketplace Tech is Ready
8:05 - Land Sale Video
9:10 - Official Zone Name for "Life on the Farm"
10:00 - Special Guest: Buddy
10:48 - Official Zone Names for "Wild West"
11:00 - Official Zone Names "Eastern"
12:30 - Land Sale Dates
13:30 - Wen Land Prices?
15:00 - Land Sale Details + Rarities
17:05 - The Great Land Grab
19:54 - DripDropz
21:22 - Special Guest: Julian (Team Member)
32:17 - LEAK - Copias Land Plot Size
37:04 - LEAK - Large Custom Dome Size
38:17 - One Last Leak
